node.title: H3 global product/quotient resultant compression
node.statement: For dyadic n, the complete shifted-root polynomial is F_n(X)=((1-X)^n-1)/X. The ordered product polynomial is Res_X(F_n(X),X^(n-1)F_n(T/X)); the nonidentity quotient polynomial is Res_X(F_n(X),F_n(TX))/(n(T-1)^(n-1)); and every cleared first-nineteen derivative packet is one bivariate resultant modulo U^19. This removes factor enumeration when constructing the two global polynomials, but does not eliminate the quotient-lift packet index, bound the exceptional integer, or supply an official-scale resultant algorithm.
